Level 4 - Advanced 55 min Concurrency Top concurrency ask

Preventing Double Booking: Pessimistic vs Optimistic Locking

"Two users click the last seat at the same millisecond. What happens?" This is the most common concurrency follow-up in LLD rounds (seats, cabs, parking spots, the last item in stock). Learn the race, the four standard answers (per-resource locks, versions with compare-and-set, temporary holds with a TTL, and database guards), and how to pick one out loud.
